agenda_items.title: Mayor Toor raised concerns about the future of the Eco-pass program for Downtown area Urged council to support funding for CAGID Eco-pass - urged policy discussion on this prior to Budget process if any major changes are going to be proposed.
Jack Stoakes identified that BID meters not within the CAGID district should be addressed as well during the budget discussion
Robin Bohannan urged support of the Volunteerathon
Mark Ruzzin noted that the Consortium of Cities and County-wide housing authorities met and agreed to begin meeting to address collaboration across the county
Crystal Gray gave a Cuba Sister City Update noting that medical equipment is being donated and Rhumba is having a fund raiser to fund the shipping costs to Cuba
Crystal Gray suggested drafting letters of congratulations to newly elected officials in the county.
PUBLIC COMMENT ON MATTERS
FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS
ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:30 P.M

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Bohannan moved, seconded by Schultheiss to approve consent items 3A through 3M with item 3I removed.

Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by Stoakes to adopt Ordinance No. 7352 designating the structure and its site located at 820 Pine Street, also known as the William V. Casey House, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.
Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Stoakes to approve the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan changes and Action plan as amended
Councilmember Toor offered a friendly amendment to amend the Action Plan 7 12 page 123 - (not cross out first 4 columns) and page 125 - 2 nd bullet to include a library site.
Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by Schultheiss to remove 2818 Jay Road.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 1.8, Gray in favor

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Bohannan moved, seconded by Gray to table item 3I and direct CAC to re-schedule when appropriate.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7.2, McGrath and Toor opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Stoakes to approve Council policy guidelines for Boards and Commissions

Councilmember McGrath moved, seconded by Riggle to approve a letter stating the city position on Rocky Flats National Wildlife Refuge - Draft Comprehensive Conservation Plan and Environmental Impact Statement supporting alternative C.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:30 P.M
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:30 P.M

open_comment_speakers.name: Tim Thomas
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: consent item 3K - urged that council pull this item (not ready), supported the occupancy ordinance but urges expanding it to allow four unrelated people to live together.

open_comment_speakers.name: Michael Kennedy
open_comment_speakers.topic: re. CATV - opposed to the continuation of funding for Channel 54 Stressed that self censorship is needed and that CATV is a steward for public access TV.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ken Wilson
open_comment_speakers.topic: WRAB member and University Hill Member speaking to 4 issues 1) Water - new billing system a must just as is a new rate structure 2) Noise Ordinance - supported 3) Outdoor furniture ordinance - supported making a permanent ordinance 4) Occupancy ordinance - large amount of neighborhood concerns - urged Council to table to allow for adequate public process.

open_comment_speakers.topic: a Doctor and mother asking for community support for the Kid's Day America on May 15 th to raise funds for the Ronald McDonald House and the Boulder Safehouse

open_comment_speakers.name: Jan Otto
open_comment_speakers.topic: opposed to the proposed occupancy ordinance - Item has been rushed and should be tabled to allow further public process.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: urge passing an ordinance prohibiting talking gas pumps Expressed disappointment that the 29 th Street project does not include any pocket park area

open_comment_speakers.name: Eleanor DePuy
